name: bootstrap_patricians
description: D-062 reference replay: original build order and island assignment, footprints replanned locally; surgery deferred until Patricians and glass. No stock grants, pauses or target changes. Farms moved off the start island (the D-065 chain plots leave oc-01 too little grass for its last wheat_farm, and wheat grows only on oc-01 among the settled islands): the 11th to 14th pig_farm stand on oc-06, served by a fourth cog on a new route 4 (stone out, pigs home); later ships and routes are renumbered; the eighth wheat_farm comes before the second apiary. D-080 (content 0.23.0): one producer now feeds 40–60 houses of its tier, so the plan builds a final producer (and its farm) only where the peak demand of the game asks for it. The Patricians game adds one fisher, two sheep farms and weavers, two wheat farms, a mill and a bakery, a salt pan, an apiary, a tannery, a slaughterhouse and a pig farm per pig island to the Merchants game's chains (no further brewery, butcher, tailor, meadery, cheese dairy or printing press); with fewer warehouses the last six warehouse upgrades are gone. A second clay pit and brickworks go up before the university and the cathedral (240 bricks; one brickworks took close to four hours for them). D-083 (content 0.24.0): the iron mine and smelter on island 2 come after the first Patrician house (tier 4), before the cooperage; no tools on any route.
